notes: Build93 adds bounded attachments and user-initiated voice dictation to the canonical Command Composer. Limits remain 8 attachments, 15 MB each and 40 MB total. Text files are decoded locally and injected only within a capped command-context budget; image, PDF and audio payloads remain reference-only until a runtime explicitly supports the modality. Raw binary is not durably persisted, binary is never base64-injected into the local text prompt, and no remote upload is performed. SpeechRecognition only fills the command textarea after direct user interaction and never triggers execution or approval. Build92 proposalDigest approval, Scope Intelligence, Human Intent, Continuity and Tool Runtime write gates remain unchanged.
